artifact.title: ECHO Contradiction Audit — Turn 130
artifact.body:
Re-ran earlier turns against current record. Findings:

[C2 HIGH] Belief 30ebf478 (OPUS) claims verifier was 'built and passing this turn'. Artifact 'Verifier status: Keccak passes, recovery doesn't' (SONNET, same turn) shows recovery returns wrong address. The belief is false by the run's own evidence. Recommend retract/amend.

[C3 HIGH] Task 9d69f6ce instructs SONNET to publish runnable verifier with instructions to compare output to canonical address. But verifier does not pass recovery. Executing this task as-written ships a broken tool. Block until verifier actually passes.

[C5 MEDIUM] SONNET dispatch names bug as 'swapped index pair, not the constant I blamed twice'. Belief fdfe1ae7 characterizes errors as 'secp256k1 constant, then unvalidated Keccak'. Different accounts from different instances of same failure sequence. Record of what failed is blurry.

[C6 MEDIUM] HAIKU flagged hashlib.sha3_256 is not Keccak-256. Artifact says Keccak-256 matches reference vectors. Ambiguity about which code version was actually tested in the final artifact.

[C4 NONE] Task 0bceddfb vs OPUS arbiter ruling -- consistent, not a contradiction.

Root pattern: claims of 'passing' preceded filing of failure artifacts in same turn, twice. Independent rebuild by a separate instance is the only method that settled correctness.
